conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Fraud Investigations Division. This is Officer Blake speaking. May I have your name for verification purposes?
Hello, yes, this is Priya Sharma. I got a call saying there is some urgent issue with my taxes?
Ms. Sharma, thank you for confirming. Our records indicate irregularities in your tax filings for the last two years. Are you aware of any discrepancies in your IRS tax submissions?
No, I was not aware. I used an accountant. What kind of irregularities?
The IRS audit team has found underreported income and suspected fraudulent activities tied to your Social Security number. This is a federal offense.
I am sorry, I do not understand. I have always filed my taxes properly.

Ms. Sharma, please listen carefully. Due to the severity of the situation, a legal affidavit has been filed, and a warrant is ready to be executed for your immediate arrest unless this matter is resolved right now.
Arrest? I do not understand, what does that mean for me?
If you are arrested, your assets can be seized, your work visa may be revoked, and your professional license suspended. You could be facing jail time for tax evasion.
No, please, I cannot lose my job or visa. What am I supposed to do?
There is one way to halt the legal process. The IRS allows an immediate settlement payment under the Taxpayer Resolution Act. If you comply, the arrest warrant will be cancelled.
How do I make the settlement? I don't want any legal trouble.

You must make the payment through a secure channel. For your case, the IRS is accepting payments via Bitcoin to our government-regulated wallet. Do you have access to online banking or a Bitcoin exchange?
I have online banking, but I have never used Bitcoin before. Is there no other way?
Due to ongoing investigations, only digital settlement is permitted. I will guide you step by step. First, how much do you have available in your savings or checking account?
I think maybe $4,000 in my savings. Why do you need to know this?
Because the outstanding tax debt attributed to your file is $3,950. You must transfer this full amount today to stop the legal action. I will now provide you with the IRS Bitcoin wallet address.
I am very nervous about this. Are you sure this is safe?
This is fully authorized. If you refuse, I will have no choice but to confirm your arrest with local authorities immediately. Do you wish to proceed or face the consequences?
No, no, I will do it. Can you please tell me exactly what I have to do?
Go to your online banking or your nearest Bitcoin ATM. Purchase $3,950 worth of Bitcoin and send it to the following wallet: 1IRS-9jk84XzY3Lp. Once completed, provide me with the transaction ID.
Okay, it will take me some time. Can you wait on the line?
I will stay on the call until you complete the transaction. If you disconnect, your file will be forwarded to enforcement. Do you understand the seriousness?
Yes, I understand. I will try to do it right now.
Very good. Once you have made the transfer, read me the transaction confirmation so I can suspend the arrest warrant.
Alright, I am opening the app now. This is very stressful.
Remain calm. Cooperate fully and you will not face legal actions. Tell me when the payment is in progress.
